ATG.note: Source: Antigua and Barbuda Country Poverty Assessment 2005/06, Statistics Division (expenditure survey).

BHR.note: Source: UNU-WIDER WIID, Bahrain Household Expenditure and Income Survey (Information and eGovernment Authority). Household income per person, so it includes the migrant workforce; not directly comparable with consumption-based figures.

CUB.note: Source: Columbia Law School Cuba Capacity Building Project, An Approach to Poverty in Cuba: the Gini index "exceeded 0.4 in the 2010s". No exact official figure is published.

BRN.why: World Economics' 63.4 rejected: the World Bank has no Brunei Gini and the statistics office's own income shares do not support it

ERI.why: no estimate in any source examined
